title: Task Types
description: The task types a project recognises, each with the archetype nit:tasks proposes by default. Keyed by the `type` enum in task.schema.json — an entry keyed by an archetype id is never found, because the lookup is by task type.

id.description: A task type from task.schema.json's `type` enum, not an archetype id.

defaultArchetype.description: The archetype nit:tasks proposes for this type by default. Must name an archetype shipped in cli/archetypes/.
